family.description: This entry includes Mitochondrial outer membrane protein OM14 from yeast and similar fungal sequences. OM14 is a mitochondrial membrane receptor for cytosolic ribosomes. It interacts with the nascent chain-associated complex (NAC) bound to ribosomes, contributing to co-translational mitochondrial import [[cite:PUB00155773],[cite:PUB00089691]]. This entry represents two transmembrane found at the C-terminal of OM14.
family.name: Mitochondrial outer membrane protein OM14, C-terminal
